data.name: Fanaiah
data.gender_notes: Fanaiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of great devotion and spiritual depth, one who transcends worldly concerns and strives for the divine. The name Fanaiah carries the meaning “Devotion, Transcendence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fanaiah usually hope their child will grow to embody devotion, transcendence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who is deeply devoted to her faith and seeks to transcend the material world.
data.etymology: Fanaiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotion, Transcendence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fanaiah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فناءية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفناء و الانتهاء في الحياة الدنيا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فناءية مشتق من الفاء و النون و الألف و الياء ، و هو اسم ذو معنى عميق في الثقافة الإسلامية ، حيث يدل على الفناء و الانتهاء في الحياة الدنيا و الانتقال إلى الحياة الآخرة ، و يرتبط بالآية القرآنية 'كل من عليها فان و يبقى وجه ربك ذو الجلال و الإكرام' ، و هو اسم يوحي بالتوكل على الله و الرضا بقضائه

in_urdu.name: فناءیہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو دنیا سے گزرنے اور آخرت کی زندگی میں داخل ہونے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فناءیہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے ، اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ دنیا سے گزرنا اور آخرت کی زندگی میں داخل ہونا ، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں گہرا معنی رکھتا ہے ، جہاں یہ دنیا کی ناپائیداری اور آخرت کی زندگی کی اہمیت کو یاد دلاتا ہے ، اور یہ قرآن مجید میں 'کل من عليها فان' کی آیت سے منسلک ہے

in_hindi.name: फनाया
in_hindi.meaning: दुनिया से गुजरने और आखिरत की जिंदगी में प्रवेश करने का संकेत करने वाला नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फनाया नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं , और इसका अर्थ है दुनिया से गुजरना और आखिरत की जिंदगी में प्रवेश करना , यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में गहरा अर्थ रखता है , जहां यह दुनिया की अनिश्चितता और आखिरत की जिंदगी के महत्व को याद दिलाता है , और यह कुरआन में 'كل من عليها فان' की आयत से जुड़ा हुआ है

in_pashto.name: فانيه

in_english.name: Fanaiah
in_english.meaning: Name signifies passing away from worldly life to eternal life
in_english.long_meaning: Fanaiah is derived from Arabic roots , signifying the transition from worldly life to eternal life , this name holds deep meaning in Islamic culture , reminding of the impermanence of worldly life and the importance of the hereafter , related to the Quranic verse 'كل من عليها فان' , symbolizing trust in God's decree and acceptance of His will

data.cultural_impact: The name Fanaiah holds deep cultural significance within the Islamic community. With the root word "Faniyah" meaning "one who is lost in God" or "one who has devoted herself entirely to God," the name Fanaiah is often given to a woman who embodies the profound spiritual devotion expected of every Muslim. The cultural impact of a name like Fanaiah lies in the ideal that is set for women in Islamic society; one of deep spiritual connection to God and transcendence of worldly matters.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Fanaiah is rooted in the Islamic teachings of self-obliteration or "Fana," the ultimate goal of Sufi mysticism. Fanaiah refers to a woman who has reached a state of divine union with God, where her individual self is lost in the infinite and absolute reality of God. It is a profound state of spiritual transcendence, where all earthly concerns fade away, replaced by the overwhelming divine love and presence. The significance of the name Fanaiah goes beyond just being a title; it is a reminder of the infinite potential for spiritual growth and union with the Divine, especially for women, in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Devotion, Transcendence" symbolizes A woman of great devotion and spiritual depth, one who transcends worldly concerns and strives for the divine.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fanaiah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of devotion, transcendence.
